name: Melchizedek
overview: Melchizedek, identified in Scripture as the king of Salem and priest of the Most High God, uniquely combines royal and priestly roles as seen when he brought bread and wine to Abram and blessed him after his victory (Genesis 14:18-20). This encounter highlights Melchizedek's authority and divine appointment, which is further emphasized in Psalm 110 where the LORD declares a priesthood forever in the order of Melchizedek (Psalms 110:1,4). Thus, Melchizedek serves as a significant type of Christ, illustrating the eternal and sovereign priesthood that Christ embodies.
